_note: Space Marine detachment modifiers — game mechanics only. Re-verified against workspace/detachment_research/space-marines.json corpus (2026-08-23, saved Wahapedia 11e Space Marines Faction Pack v1.1). Conditional/voluntary/rotational mechanics no longer modelled as always-on.

GLADIUS TASK FORCE._engine_note: Combat Doctrines: Devastator (shoot after Advance), Tactical (shoot+charge after Fall Back), Assault (charge after Advance). Each used once per battle. Cannot be modelled as always-on modifier — rotational doctrine system.

BLADE OF ULTRAMAR._engine_note: Enhanced Combat Doctrines — same as Gladius but with Calgar can reuse a Doctrine. Requires specific character. Cannot be modelled as universal modifier.

CERAMITE SENTINELS._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). Models in terrain re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1. Units wholly in terrain, not set up this turn and not having moved more than 3", gain ENTRENCHED keyword (used by detachment stratagems). Not modelled: Hit/Wound 1s re-roll only while unit is within a terrain feature; ENTRENCHED keyword conditional on terrain + <=3" movement, consumed by stratagems

STORMLANCE TASK FORCE._engine_note: Verified 11e from corpus (2026-08-23). Lightning Assault: all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units eligible to charge in a turn they Advanced or Fell Back. Modelled as advance_and_charge per corpus; the Fall Back half has no separate key.

choices.name: Lightning Assault
choices.description: All Adeptus Astartes units can Advance and charge, and Fall Back and charge.
choices._engine_note: Corpus models advance_and_charge army-wide; charging after Fall Back is covered qualitatively by the same rule, no separate key.

ARMOURED SPEARTIP._engine_note: Rapid Deployment: units disembarking from Transport that Normal/Advanced can make D6" move. Positional mechanic — cannot modelled as universal DPP/SURV modifier.

IRONSTORM SPEARHEAD._engine_note: Verified 11e from corpus (2026-08-23). Once per phase each unit may re-roll ONE Hit OR Wound OR Damage roll — NOT modelable as a blanket reroll key without overstating.

choices.name: Armoured Wrath
choices.description: All Adeptus Astartes units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 (one each per phase).
choices._engine_note: Single re-roll of one chosen Hit OR Wound OR Damage die per unit per phase — materially weaker than blanket reroll 1s. PREVIOUSLY modelled as reroll 1s hit+wound; stripped per corpus.

FIRESTORM ASSAULT FORCE._engine_note: Verified 11e from corpus (2026-08-23). All ranged weapons gain ASSAULT; ranged attacks vs targets within 12" get +1 Strength — neither expressible as an always-on numeric modifier.

choices.name: Close-Range Eradication
choices.description: All ranged weapons gain ASSAULT. Ranged weapons gain +1 Strength when targeting units within 12".
choices._engine_note: +1 Strength vs targets within 12" is profile-dependent (no Strength key in vocabulary); ASSAULT grant is a mobility interaction. PREVIOUSLY approximated as a flat strength bonus field; stripped per corpus.

VANGUARD SPEARHEAD._engine_note: Verified 11e from corpus (2026-08-23). Ranged attacks targeting your units from beyond 12" grant Benefit of Cover. Not expressible in vocabulary (ignore_cover is offensive-only); approximating as Stealth would be wrong.

choices.name: Shadow Masters
choices.description: All Adeptus Astartes units have Stealth (-1 to hit from ranged attacks beyond 12").
choices._engine_note: Rule grants Benefit of Cover vs ranged attacks from beyond 12" — a save modifier, distinct from Stealth which affects hit rolls; no vocabulary key. PREVIOUSLY modelled stealth: true; stripped per corpus.

1ST COMPANY TASK FORCE._engine_note: Extremis-Level Threat: once per battle, army can re-roll Wound rolls vs Oath of Moment target. One-use ability — cannot modelled as always-on.

ANVIL SIEGE FORCE._engine_note: Verified 11e from corpus (2026-08-23). Net effect depends on playstyle (moved = -1 to hit) — cannot be expressed as an always-on bonus.

choices.name: Shield of the Imperium
choices.description: All ranged weapons gain HEAVY. Weapons that already have HEAVY get +1 to Wound when the unit Remained Stationary.
choices._engine_note: HEAVY on all ranged weapons is a weapon-profile change (it imposes -1 to hit after moving); +1 to Wound applies only to weapons that already had HEAVY and only when Remained Stationary. PREVIOUSLY modelled as always-active Heavy bonus; stripped per corpus.

Enhanced Oath of Moment: Oath of Moment bearers re-roll WOUND rolls of 1 vs the Oath target only (Caanok Var enables one retarget per battle round when the target dies; IRON HANDS-only). choices._engine_note: Verified mechanic: Oath of Moment bearers re-roll WOUND rolls of 1 vs the Oath target only. PREVIOUSLY fabricated as full hit rerolls +1W army-wide; stripped — conditional on the single designated Oath target, not expressible as always-on.

HEADHUNTER TASK FORCE._engine_note: Verified 11e from corpus (2026-08-23). TANK ACE vehicles: fixed 6" Advance; re-roll Damage rolls when shooting only in turns they did not Advance.

choices.name: Target Sighted
choices.description: Adeptus Astartes Vehicles re-roll Damage rolls (if they didn't Advance this turn).
choices._engine_note: Damage re-roll conditional on the unit NOT Advancing this turn, vehicles only. PREVIOUSLY modelled as unconditional reroll_damage; stripped per corpus.

ORBITAL ASSAULT FORCE._engine_note: Verified 11e from corpus (2026-08-23). Selected non-TITANIC units gain Deep Strike; arrival-turn re-roll Wound 1s (plus Hit 1s from Drop Pods) — turn-of-arrival conditional.

choices.description: Units re-roll Wound rolls of 1 on the turn they arrive from reserves.
choices._engine_note: Re-rolls apply only on the turn a unit arrives from Deep Strike / disembarks a Drop Pod. PREVIOUSLY modelled as always-on reroll_wounds 1s; stripped per corpus.

choices._engine_note: Rule grants Benefit of Cover vs ranged attacks from beyond 12" — a save modifier, distinct from Stealth which affects hit rolls; no vocabulary key. PREVIOUSLY modelled stealth: true; stripped per corpus.

LIBRARIUS CONCLAVE._engine_note: Verified 11e from corpus (2026-08-23). Choose-one Psychic Discipline per battle round: Biomancy (+2" M), Divination (re-roll 1s), Pyromancy (+1 AP within 12"), Telekinesis (-1 S incoming ranged), Telepathy (ignore hit modifiers). PSYKER units only.

choices.name: Divination
choices.description: PSYKER units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 (Divination discipline).
choices._engine_note: Divination (re-roll Hit/Wound 1s) is one of five rotating disciplines picked fresh each battle round for PSYKER units — rotation makes none always-on. PREVIOUSLY modelled Divination as permanent; stripped per corpus.

SUBVERSION ASSETS._engine_note: Nowhere to Hide: PHOBOS and SCOUT SQUAD units get detection abilities. Niche utility — no DPP/SURV modifier.

FULGURIS TASK FORCE._engine_note: Skystrike: LAND SPEEDER/STORM SPEEDER units gain SPEEDER keyword and turn 1 ingress. Speeder-specific buff — limited unit pool.

RECLAMATION FORCE._engine_note: Verified from corpus (2026-08-23). Melee attacks vs units within range of an objective marker get +1 AP. Attacks vs your ADEPTUS ASTARTES units subtract 1 from Wound rolls if the target is within range of an objective you controlled at phase start, or if the target has the TITUS keyword. ULTRAMARINES-only restriction. Not modelled: +1 AP melee conditional on target within objective range; -1 to Wound defensive buff conditional on holding objectives at phase start / TITUS keyword
